Data Analyst
Contoso Retail - Columbus, OH

Contoso Retail runs 80 stores across the Midwest. The analytics team turns sales and survey data
into the weekly numbers store managers act on.

Requirements
- Completed bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics or a related field
- 1+ year of full-time experience as a data analyst
- SQL and Python for cleaning and joining large datasets
- Building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI

Preferred
- Experience with survey data
- Explaining findings to store managers who are not analysts

Full-time, on site in Columbus. Health, dental and a 401(k) match.
